She was born Napoléone Marie Hélène Charlotte de Montholon-Sémonville in Saint Helena while Albine and Montholon were with Napoleon in exile there . Camerata-Passionei di Mazzoleni was one of the maîtres des requêtes au Conseil d'État , but committed suicide at the age of twenty-six after being prevented from marrying an actress .
